[FMLA 16] SprgPendulum — Cycle of Spring Pendulum

Period of a mass-spring oscillator.

Calculator scroll name: SprgPendulum. Period of a mass-spring oscillator.

formula
T=2πkm​​

Same idea as the pendulum, but the “restoring” piece is the spring. T = 2π m/k​.

keys
FMLA→1→6

Primary inputs: m, k.

steps

How to run

  1. Press FMLA, then 1, then 6 (or scroll to the name and EXE)
  2. Enter each prompted value
  3. Read the result

Example

  1. FMLA → 1 → 6
  2. Enter m, k
  3. Spring-mass period
note

SI: m in kg, k in N/m (both > 0); T in seconds.
